verdict: Leads are coming in efficiently, but spend levels need attention this month.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, you received 122 leads from Meta at a cost of $11.25 per lead — and in just the past 7 days, cost per lead dropped 47% while leads still grew, a genuine efficiency gain driven by the retargeting campaign. The concern is spend: daily ad spend has fallen sharply over the past few weeks, and with August being a milestone month for lead volume, the current pace risks falling short before month-end. At the same time, attribution tracking that would connect those leads to actual patient appointments is still being repaired, so the full picture of what those 122 leads produced isn't yet visible. We're actively monitoring spend levels and expect the attribution and contact tracking fixes to be in place by end of August, which will give a trusted read on the full August scoreboard.

highlights.phrase: leads received this period, all through Meta paid ads
cost per lead this period, down 47% in the most recent week
actions taken on your Google Business Profile this period — calls, directions, and website clicks

watch_item.issue: Daily ad spend has dropped significantly over the past few weeks, which could limit total lead volume for August before the month closes.
watch_item.fix: Spend levels are being reviewed now to ensure the remainder of August delivers against the volume target.
